name: Ikobi
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.note: Only Ikobi-Mena Swadesh lists located (archive.org/rosettaproject); no phonology/grammar found

sources.citation: Bullock, Juliann. 2015. The Sociolinguistic Situation in the Kaser Area. SIL Electronic Survey Report 2015-001. Dallas: SIL International. 73 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on word stress. Appendix A 'Language characteristics' (printed p.34) states negation in Ikobi (and Mouwase, Barikewa) 'can be indicated tonally' with the pair kàrímào 'he is sitting' / kárímào 'he is not sitting'; wordlists in App. C carry pitch diacritics but no stress marks or prosodic commentary.
